newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures settle off highs after US data.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures settle off highs after US data.

text.p: 1510 GMT - Bond futures end MATIF session unchanged well short of early levels after technical push fizzled out; contract dip accentuated after strong afternoon U.S. industrial production data seen as keeping U.S. rate hike fears alive. *Jun 10-yr future unch 129.02. Vol 127,099. Open 129.34 *5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.73 pct vs 5.70. Bund spd -12 vs -13 *Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Jun PIBOR 96.67, down 3 bp
